name: my dorm has a hole in it
source:
A Snoot fangame made in 24 hours.

You're nobody, a human in a world of snoots and tails, waiting in your dorm for life to finally start.

And now there's this hole, ruining everything.

What are you going to do about it?

[From [url=https://biggirlswithsharpteeth.itch.io/mydorm]Itch.io[/url]]
